mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a near-term monetary policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy response expectation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate, indicates a weakening in real economic output, which triggers a flight to safety and risk-off behavior, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 12-month MA and UNRATE > 6.5%, or the signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 1550 thousand units, combined with a rising trend in real personal consumption (RSAFS), signals strong private demand and inflationary pressure, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST > 1550 and RSAFS is rising, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressures that increase the probability of a near-term rate hike, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with low policy rates
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or the joint signal fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and the likelihood of future monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 200 and UNRATE is declining, or the interaction signal has a Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter, combined with a simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO), signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which increases the probability of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 declines and INDPRO is falling, or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.
